title: Navalny
description: Replaces zombie and it's baby variant with Navalny
body:
**This resource pack replaces _zombie_ and _it's baby variant_ with Navalny, also adding _custom sounds_.**

**❗It doesnt replace husk or drowned.**

Navalny became a meme in Russia, mostly because of his face being covered in brilliant green, so i had to replace him with Minecraft zombie.

NOTE: This resource pack works with _any version_, before or after baby variants update.
